bufferFirst: The buffer comes first. A habit waits until the safe surplus floor is above zero.
title: Steady long-term habit
intro: A small pot from your monthly safe surplus. Bitcoin is one option, not the only one.
sensiQuote: A patient pot for 3 to 5 years. You approve each purchase.
satsNote: Sats appear when there is a quote. Goes straight to your own wallet.
cadenceNote: Monthly is the usual habit. Weekly is an option. The amount stays at or below the safe floor.
saved: Habit saved on this phone. Nothing is sent until you approve a purchase.
remindSet: We'll remind you on the 1st. You approve each purchase.
remindStays: A reminder stays on this phone. It does not send money.
remindAfterSave: Save the habit first. The reminder uses that saved amount.
nothingToSet: There is no amount to set, and nothing is purchased.
cashBody: Money you may need soon. Watch out for treating it as spare cash.
everydayBody: M-Shwari, Ziidi, a money market fund, or a SACCO. Watch the fees and the lock-up.
bitcoinBody: Good for 3 to 5 years or more. The value goes up and down, and you can lose money.
keys: Keys stay on your device · Backup is coming soon
skipMonth: You can skip a month. Nothing moves until you approve it.
disclaimer: Past performance does not indicate future results. This is education, not financial advice. Bitcoin can lose value.

errors.whole: Enter a whole number of shillings.
errors.exceeds: The habit cannot exceed the safe floor of {floor}.
errors.save: Could not save this habit on this phone.
errors.reminder: Could not save the reminder on this phone.

reminder.title: PesaSense reminder
reminder.body: The 1st is a day to review {amount}. You approve each purchase. Nothing is sent on its own.
reminder.saved: Reminder saved for the 1st ({amount}). You approve each purchase.
